authority: ../PROTOCOL.md is canonical. This is derived operational context; source controls conflicts.
version: Record available repository/ref/full containing Git commit from version metadata. Producer source_snapshot is not runtime adoption or a version manifest.
activation: Official installation intent starts full_install immediately after required initial explanation; other requests use the applicable lifecycle route.

steps.instruction: Interpret the owner's invocation as scoped install-and-prepare intent. Persist newly authored human-readable content in English, preserving technical literals and raw external evidence under the language exceptions; communicate each action's purpose, actual status/result and necessary human action briefly in the user's preferred language: honor an applicable voluntary explicit user language request, otherwise a trustworthy current applicable preference evidenced by previous conversations, otherwise the trustworthy runtime locale or user-account preference, otherwise the triggering user's prompt language. An English command, generated prompt or quotation is not an explicit language choice. Establish language_source_discovery and presentation_language_resolved before the earliest controllable user-facing output: use a valid explicit choice or bounded authorized inspection of available conversation-preference evidence and actual runtime/account capabilities/settings under the first mandatory language rule. Retain scoped source/disposition/time/context and trust/applicability evidence; not_attempted is not unavailable. Unknown preference stays unknown; after a documented capability check use a transparent provisional fallback without a language questionnaire, profile service or polling. A command-only CTA is not attributable natural-language evidence; disclose unsupported first-output interception and never invent host observations. Do not require redundant confirmation or a technical questionnaire.

Establish current project/workspace identity, root and sufficient authority before consuming project-private state or writing. Discover actual fetch, filesystem and coordination capabilities; a URL grants none. Unknown or mismatched identity/authority blocks dependent effects; preserve other projects and continue independent authorized safe work.

Discover an eligible project-owned private root or safely prepare it within authority, normally <project-root>/.priv. Before private checkout writes, inspect tracked paths as well as explicit VCS exclusion, prevent accidental staging/commit and establish feasible file protection and authorized access boundaries. An ignore rule does not untrack existing data. If protection fails, repair safely or block dependent writes.

Inspect authorized same-project binding/shared references for an existing OOP checkout before cloning. Retain a valid equivalent and non-secret mapping; do not infer ownership from a name or trust unknown/symlink destinations. For a genuinely absent checkout, prepare protected <project-private-root>/common/oop and its common parent only as needed. Serialize acquisition and Git mutation, recheck actual state after coordination and reuse a peer's completed acquisition; unavailable safe serialization blocks contested effects. Never blindly move, overwrite or duplicate existing state.

Obtain the owner-selected canonical repository using available authorized access or reuse its eligible current-project local checkout. The remote entry locator, repository URL, local checkout, local distribution and runtime-adopted commit are distinct. Use a safe documented equivalent access path when needed. If remote fetch/write is unavailable, use an eligible authorized local fallback or report the precise dependent limitation; never claim installation success. Do not audit OOP content, compare files to commits, verify signatures/tags/hashes/inventories/publisher/TOFU or run release tests; repository/release verification remains not_performed.

Reuse scoped shared same-day freshness evidence; perform at most one due fetch per configured repository/ref/local calendar day with bounded retries and shared failure evidence. Fast-forward only a clean eligible tracking branch. Preserve dirty, divergent, detached/pinned or offline state without reset, stash, overwrite, branch switching or automatic same-day retry; remote latest remains unknown offline. A rewritten ref may be obtained separately only under the existing safe isolated acquisition policy. Record available/local status separately; updating shared bytes never advances any runtime's adopted checkpoint, controls, adapters or authority.

Once the checkout is available, read its local PROTOCOL.md, then its local dist/entry.json and applicable referenced context. Resolve relative distribution paths only there; the remote locator is not a local base. Continue all BOOT-01–BOOT-13, full protection, compatibility/migration, independent active-runtime adoption and actual installed-control/access checks, reusing valid observed work. For a proved human-only dependency show the smallest necessary decision and observable resume condition, verify the answer/result and resume automatically when the host delivers a real continuation event; otherwise provide the precise portable reentry instruction without promising an unsolicited future turn. Preserve prior verified history and actual partial effects; report scoped readiness only from actual evidence.

enforcement.permission: Adapter observations and actual native prevention remain independently required.

contract_binding.$clause: Evaluate the complete semantic_clause for that dimension, with its exact quantified scope, conditions, exceptions and normative force.
contract_binding.$clause+core: Evaluate the clause and Core for that dimension. No inferred generic permission or invented fact.
contract_binding.actor: source-qualified actor means the actual actor specified by the complete clause; references do not change ownership.
contract_binding.examples: Source examples remain conditional illustrations, never independent authority.
contract_binding.hashes: Content identities are producer provenance/reference metadata. Consumers do not recompute, compare to Git or certify OOP artifacts.

context: Union classified semantic facets then dependencies; load only missing/stale selected context. Resolve material unknowns before effects, never infer permission.
consumer_exclusion: Never run maintainer commands, schemas as release tests, OOP repository audits, hashes/signatures/inventories/publisher/TOFU checks during consumer lifecycle. Consumer-local access and necessary post-bootstrap path assurance remain distinct; no active hook tests at bootstrap.
runtime: Select supported existing mechanisms under canonical authority; this package does not install controls, prove provider access or claim Full OOP runtime governance.
